question: Can downstream task-tangent pullback identify a stable compact set of exact native M11 weight factors where output-reconstruction greedy fails?

searched: v17 restricted tensor and valid v18 frozen factor transfer
task-tangent, response-basis, source compiler, hidden-mask, and downstream-reader records
AGENT_BOARD, BILIN18_CONNECTION, BENCHMARK_BACKLOG, and canonical temporal dossier
prior_art.known_result: Output-greedy is exactly implemented but diffuse: 256 factors leave .75-.77 training output residual, recover .654 held-out causality, and breach C selectivity. High output variance is not the circuit target. Downstream readers can amplify a small task-aligned component, as earlier source-complement experiments demonstrated.
prior_art.novelty: No prior factorization pulls the actual is/was answer-margin covector back to M11 output and contracts it with every native rank-one M11 factor across constructions before causal testing.

frozen_design.selection_population: All v17 A2 and v18 A1 rows. V18 A2/P/C are held out from the new ordering; v19 causal outcomes remain sealed.
frozen_design.task_tangent: At the writer-present M11 output, detach and re-enable gradients only at that module boundary, run the exact downstream checkpoint, and differentiate the summed per-row toward-donor answer margin. For factor n and sample s, t[s,n]=delta_h[s,n] * <grad_margin[s], Down[:,n]>. The sum over n is the first-order prediction for complete M11 removal.
frozen_design.stable_order: For each selection construction, average t[:,n] and normalize by the sum of absolute per-unit means. Score unit n by the minimum of its two normalized signed contributions. Sort descending with smallest index breaking exact ties; freeze the first 256 indices. Coefficients remain exactly one. Report prefixes 16,32,64,128,256.
frozen_design.tangent_validation: Run complete M11 removal on both selection constructions. The summed factor tangent must predict its margin-effect vector with cosine >=.90 and direction >=.875 before the ordering is considered a valid task-conditioned instrument.
frozen_design.causal_test: Apply frozen factor prefixes to the full v18 A2 M11 reader delta and compare with complete M11 loss. Separately normalize P/C top-64/top-128 movements by target RMS. V19 remains unopened.

predictions.pred_a_authority_gradient_and_formula_in: Authorities/populations match; boundary gradient is live and finite; writer/all-hidden replays close; hook counts and exact 41-forward/2-backward price pass.
predictions.pred_b_summed_native_factor_tangent_pred: On v17 A2 and v18 A1 separately, summed tangent versus complete M11 removal has cosine >=.90 and direction >=.875.
predictions.pred_c_stable_task_tangent_top64_transfe: Frozen top-64 signed recovery/cosine/direction on v18 A2 is at least .75/.95/.875.
predictions.pred_d_stable_task_tangent_top128_recove: Frozen top-128 signed recovery/cosine/direction on v18 A2 is at least .85/.95/.875.
predictions.pred_e_task_tangent_factor_program_is_se: Every P/C top-64/top-128 normalized ratio <=.25 and no v19 causal outcome is opened.

decision: C promotes a compact task-read factor set; only D promotes <=128 if C fails. If B fails, the first-order pullback is not a valid selector and no causal prefix is promoted. If B passes but C/D fail, the downstream covector itself is construction-conditioned and the next object must explicitly branch by reader state. E failure marks generic/nonselective use. A passing order is frozen before v19 confirmation.
